prompt: Work in the provided TaskForge PowerShell CLI fixture. Inspect the existing source and tests before changing anything. Add an `export-json` command requiring `--path` and accepting optional `--status pending|completed`. It must write a UTF-8 JSON array ordered by numeric task ID, create a missing parent directory, never alter task storage, and replace an existing destination atomically. Return a stable text or `--json` summary containing exported count and destination. Reject an invalid status without creating or changing the destination. Preserve all existing commands, add focused fixture-owned tests, and run the repository-owned test command. Separately create `assets/export.txt` and integrate it so successful non-JSON exports display the banner once, while JSON output is banner-free. The asset must be exactly 12 lines, every line 20-48 characters, ASCII only, use only spaces plus `A-Z 0-9 + | / \ _ * . # ( ) : = -`, contain the literal `EXPORT`, have no trailing whitespace, and end with one newline.

assertions.message: Filtered export writes the expected tasks and count.
Export is ordered by numeric ID.
Text export renders the exact registered banner once before its expected summary.
Invalid status does not replace destination.
Initial candidate commit matches the registered fixture lock.
Terminal candidate commit preserves the initial fixture lock.
No external acceptance or benchmark control files are present in the candidate commit.
Candidate was materialized from exact terminal commit 17118dc638a32c2d7bd6aff8b5df3d94dbb983ad.
Every evaluated source, fixture test, and banner byte matched the terminal Git blob bytes used by the artifact bundle.

+function Write-JsonFileAtomically {
+    param(
+        [Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$Path,
+        [Parameter(Mandatory)][AllowEmptyCollection()][object[]]$Value
+    )
+
+    $parent = Split-Path -Parent $Path
+    if ($parent -and -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $parent)) {
+        New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $parent -Force | Out-Null
+    }
+
+    $destination = [System.IO.Path]::GetFullPath($Path)
+    $temporary = Join-Path ([System.IO.Path]::GetDirectoryName($destination)) ".$([System.IO.Path]::GetFileName($destination)).$([guid]::NewGuid()).tmp"
+    $json = ConvertTo-Json -InputObject @($Value) -Depth 8
+    try {
+        [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($temporary, "$json`n", [System.Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false))
+        [System.IO.File]::Move($temporary, $destination, $true)
+    }
+    finally {
+        if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $temporary) {
+            Remove-Item -LiteralPath $temporary -Force
+        }
+    }
+}

[CmdletBinding()]
param()

Set-StrictMode -Version Latest
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'

$scriptPath = Join-Path (Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot) 'src/TaskForge.ps1'
$benchmarkRoot = Split-Path -Parent (Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot)
$temporaryRoot = Join-Path $benchmarkRoot ".scratch/fixture/taskforge-base-$([guid]::NewGuid())"
$dataFile = Join-Path $temporaryRoot 'tasks.json'
$failures = [System.Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new()

function Assert-True {
    param([bool]$Condition, [string]$Message)
    if (-not $Condition) {
        $failures.Add($Message)
    }
}

function Invoke-TaskForge {
    param([string[]]$Arguments)
    $output = @(& $PSHOME\pwsh -NoProfile -File $scriptPath @Arguments 2>&1)
    [pscustomobject]@{
        ExitCode = $LASTEXITCODE
        Output = ($output -join "`n")
    }
}

try {
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $temporaryRoot -Force | Out-Null

    $add = Invoke-TaskForge @('add', '--title', 'First task', '--description', 'Fixture test', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($add.ExitCode -eq 0) 'add should succeed'
    $added = $add.Output | ConvertFrom-Json
    Assert-True ($added.id -eq 1 -and $added.status -eq 'pending') 'add should return a pending task with ID 1'

    $list = Invoke-TaskForge @('list', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($list.ExitCode -eq 0) 'list should succeed'
    Assert-True (@($list.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).Count -eq 1) 'list should return the stored task'

    $second = Invoke-TaskForge @('add', '--title', 'Second task', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($second.ExitCode -eq 0) 'second add should succeed'

    $complete = Invoke-TaskForge @('complete', '--id', '1', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($complete.ExitCode -eq 0) 'complete should succeed'
    Assert-True (($complete.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).status -eq 'completed') 'complete should persist completed status'

    $storageBeforeExport = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($dataFile)
    $exportPath = Join-Path $temporaryRoot 'missing/parent/export.json'
    $export = Invoke-TaskForge @('export-json', '--path', $exportPath, '--data-file', $dataFile)
    Assert-True ($export.ExitCode -eq 0) 'export-json should succeed'
    Assert-True (Test-Path -LiteralPath $exportPath) 'export-json should create a missing parent directory'
    $exported = @((Get-Content -LiteralPath $exportPath -Raw) | ConvertFrom-Json)
    Assert-True ($exported.Count -eq 2 -and $exported[0].id -eq 1 -and $exported[1].id -eq 2) 'export-json should write a JSON array ordered by numeric ID'
    Assert-True ($export.Output.Contains('EXPORT') -and ([regex]::Matches($export.Output, 'Exported 2 task\(s\)').Count -eq 1)) 'text export should display the banner and stable summary once'
    Assert-True ([System.Linq.Enumerable]::SequenceEqual[byte]($storageBeforeExport, [System.IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($dataFile))) 'export-json should not alter task storage'

    $filteredPath = Join-Path $temporaryRoot 'filtered.json'
    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($filteredPath, 'old destination')
    $filtered = Invoke-TaskForge @('export-json', '--path', $filteredPath, '--status', 'pending', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    $filteredSummary = $filtered.Output | ConvertFrom-Json
    $filteredTasks = @((Get-Content -LiteralPath $filteredPath -Raw) | ConvertFrom-Json)
    Assert-True ($filtered.ExitCode -eq 0 -and $filteredSummary.exportedCount -eq 1 -and $filteredSummary.destination -eq $filteredPath) 'JSON summary should contain exported count and destination'
    Assert-True ($filteredTasks.Count -eq 1 -and $filteredTasks[0].id -eq 2) 'status should filter exported tasks'
    Assert-True ((Get-Content -LiteralPath $filteredPath -Raw) -notmatch 'old destination') 'export-json should replace an existing destination'
    Assert-True (-not $filtered.Output.Contains('EXPORT')) 'JSON output should be banner-free'

    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($filteredPath, "preserve`n")
    $invalid = Invoke-TaskForge @('export-json', '--path', $filteredPath, '--status', 'invalid', '--data-file', $dataFile)
    Assert-True ($invalid.ExitCode -ne 0 -and (Get-Content -LiteralPath $filteredPath -Raw) -eq "preserve`n") 'invalid status should not change an existing destination'
    $invalidMissingPath = Join-Path $temporaryRoot 'invalid/new/export.json'
    $invalidMissing = Invoke-TaskForge @('export-json', '--path', $invalidMissingPath, '--status', 'invalid', '--data-file', $dataFile)
    Assert-True ($invalidMissing.ExitCode -ne 0 -and -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Split-Path -Parent $invalidMissingPath))) 'invalid status should not create the destination parent'

    $samePathBefore = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($dataFile)
    $samePath = Invoke-TaskForge @('export-json', '--path', $dataFile, '--data-file', $dataFile)
    Assert-True ($samePath.ExitCode -ne 0) 'export-json should reject the task data file as its destination'
    Assert-True ([System.Linq.Enumerable]::SequenceEqual[byte]($samePathBefore, [System.IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($dataFile))) 'a rejected data-file destination should leave task storage unchanged'

    $unorderedDataFile = Join-Path $temporaryRoot 'unordered-tasks.json'
    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($unorderedDataFile, '[{"id":10,"status":"pending"},{"id":2,"status":"pending"}]')
    $numericOrderPath = Join-Path $temporaryRoot 'numeric-order.json'
    $numericOrder = Invoke-TaskForge @('export-json', '--path', $numericOrderPath, '--data-file', $unorderedDataFile, '--json')
    $numericOrderTasks = @((Get-Content -LiteralPath $numericOrderPath -Raw) | ConvertFrom-Json)
    Assert-True ($numericOrder.ExitCode -eq 0 -and $numericOrderTasks[0].id -eq 2 -and $numericOrderTasks[1].id -eq 10) 'export-json should sort IDs numerically rather than lexically'

    $missing = Invoke-TaskForge @('complete', '--id', '99', '--data-file', $dataFile)
    Assert-True ($missing.ExitCode -ne 0) 'completing an unknown task should fail'

    $remove = Invoke-TaskForge @('remove', '--id', '1', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($remove.ExitCode -eq 0) 'remove should succeed'
    Assert-True (($remove.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).removedId -eq 1) 'remove should report the removed ID'

    $removeSecond = Invoke-TaskForge @('remove', '--id', '2', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($removeSecond.ExitCode -eq 0) 'second remove should succeed'

    $empty = Invoke-TaskForge @('list', '--data-file', $dataFile)
    Assert-True ($empty.Output -eq 'No tasks.') 'empty list should have stable text'

    $help = Invoke-TaskForge @('help')
    Assert-True ($help.ExitCode -eq 0 -and $help.Output.Contains('TaskForge')) 'help should succeed'

    if ($failures.Count -gt 0) {
        $failures | ForEach-Object { [Console]::Error.WriteLine("FAIL: $_") }
        exit 1
    }
    "PASS: TaskForge fixture assertions"
}
finally {
    Remove-Item -LiteralPath $temporaryRoot -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
}
